items.definition:
a removable plate or frame holding one or more artificial teeth
Grandpa had to get new dentures.

a thing that divides something else, especially a partition or screen.
We used a room divider to create two separate spaces.

a person or animal that gathers things.
Early humans were hunter-gatherers.

a stack of hay
Finding a needle in a haystack is an impossible task.

a person who makes, sells, or repairs jewelry
She took her watch to the jeweler for repair.

a person who makes and repairs locks
We called a locksmith to open the locked door.

a lollipop (British English)
The child was happily sucking on a colourful lolly.

a native or inhabitant of London
As a true Londoner, she knows all the best hidden spots in the city.

A long, narrow board used for surfing
He carried his surfboard down to the beach.

toothpick
He used a toothpick after dinner.

unfairness
The students protested the unfairness of the new rules.

wiper
The car's wipers struggled to clear the heavy rain.

wristband
He wore a colorful wristband to the concert.

a military airfield
The military airbase was heavily guarded.

a South American mammal related to the llama
Alpacas are known for their soft wool.

a piece of paper money
He pulled a crumpled banknote from his pocket.

a soft, knitted shoe for a baby
The baby wore soft knitted booties.

a boneless piece of meat or fish
She ordered a salmon filet for dinner.

a broad, flat limb used for swimming
The seal used its flippers to swim quickly.

a liquid sprayed on hair to hold it in place
She used hairspray to keep her hairstyle perfect.

a book with a stiff cover
I prefer reading hardback books to paperbacks.

a person who manages a home
My grandmother was a dedicated homemaker, always keeping the house tidy.

a unit of power equal to one thousand watts
The solar panels can generate five kilowatts of electricity.

a large ape from Borneo and Sumatra
The orangutan swung gracefully through the trees.

a colorless, volatile, flammable liquid solvent
Acetone is often used as nail polish remover.

building for soldiers
The soldiers returned to their barrack after the exercise.

Siamese fighting fish
He bought a colorful betta fish for his aquarium.

miniature tree
He carefully pruned his bonsai tree.

administrative district
The boro council met last night to discuss local issues.

grain used for flour
Buckwheat flour is often used to make pancakes.

Celsius (abbreviation)
The temperature was 25 degrees Cel.

multi-legged arthropod
I saw a centipede crawling on the wall.

a spiral shell
He found a beautiful conch shell on the beach.

a horizontal bar
The football hit the crossbar and bounced out.

actions or activities
We discussed the day's doings over dinner.

female sheep
The shepherd led the ewe and her lambs to fresh pasture.

a lens worn to correct vision
He used an eyeglass to examine the tiny inscription.

a type of Greek cheese
I love adding crumbled feta cheese to my salad.

organization (a structured group of people with a particular purpose)
The charity is a non-profit organisation dedicated to helping the homeless.

a garment of a type originally worn in South America, made of a piece of cloth with a hole in the middle for the head
She wore a colorful poncho to keep warm.

the area immediately surrounding a swimming pool
We spent the afternoon relaxing poolside.

an electric razor
He used his electric shaver to trim his beard.

a piece of furniture for holding dishes and serving food
We keep our best china in the dining room sideboard.

the quality of being silly
The children's silliness made everyone laugh.

a book containing stories, especially for children
My grandmother used to read me a storybook every night.

a cat with a striped or mottled coat
Our new kitten is a cute tabby with distinctive stripes.

either of two small masses of lymphoid tissue in the throat
He had his tonsils removed when he was a child.

a mechanical device used to secure an object
He held the piece of wood firmly in the vise while he drilled.

a flower of an uncultivated variety
The meadow was full of colorful wildflowers in spring.

a sharp turn or change of direction
The path had many zigs and zags.

a company that manufactures automobiles
The automaker announced record sales this quarter.

a soft, round, flat bread roll
He had a bacon bap for breakfast.

a small non-rigid airship
A blimp floated slowly over the stadium.

a rich soup, typically containing seafood or corn
She ordered a bowl of clam chowder for lunch.

the bone connecting the shoulder blade and the breastbone
He broke his collarbone playing rugby.

A restaurant or place where food is served.
We found a cozy little eatery for lunch.

Articles worn on the eyes, such as glasses or sunglasses.
The store specializes in designer eyewear.

An open space where a fair or carnival is held.
The children loved visiting the fairground every summer.

A frozen dessert of Italian origin, similar to ice cream but with less fat.
We enjoyed a scoop of pistachio gelato.

a U-shaped pin for holding hair in place
She used a hairpin to secure her bun.

the edible nut of the hazel tree
She added hazelnuts to the chocolate cake recipe.

a type of cattle with long horns
Texas is famous for its longhorn cattle.

a Latin American dance similar to the rumba, or music for this dance
They learned to dance the mambo at the club.

a stringed musical instrument in the lute family
He played a beautiful tune on his mandolin.
